title: ContextDB: A Unified Context Layer for AI Agents - Replacing the Patchwork with a Memory Operating System
senal_calidad: STRONG RECONSIDERAR FLAG: Sec.6.4 is explicitly titled 'Proposed Experimental Design' and states 'We PLAN to evaluate...We HYPOTHESIZE...We EXPECT compression-as-denoising to yield 80-90% token savings...We PLAN systematic ablations', and Sec.6.5 closes with 'Note: Full experimental results will be reported UPON COMPLETION of the implementation and evaluation pipeline' -- i.e. NO original experiments were run on ContextDB itself; all abstract headline numbers (<100ms p95, up to 90% token savings, 'targeting SOTA results') are ASPIRATIONAL, and figures in Sec.8 (HippoRAG +20%, Memory-R1 +48%F1 vs Mem0, SeCom 12-18% retrieval-precision gain) are results of OTHER cited systems, not ContextDB's own. Single-author (Gaurav Sharma, saaslabs.co) architecture-synthesis paper drawing on '200+ papers'; Table2 is a self-assessed feature CHECKLIST, not measured data. Extracted the DESIGN as described per protocol. Sec.3.2 Eq.1: token-memory tuple m=(c,e,Gs,Gt,Gc,Ge,tevent,tingest,tau) combines an embedding e (VECTOR) with four graph positions (GRAFO) -> representacion=HIBRIDA; 'Parametric Store: optional LoRA adapters' -> mem_tipos adds PARAMETRICA alongside Factual(SEMANTICA)/Experiential(EPISODICA)/Working(TRABAJO) function-mapping (Sec.3.4) -> mem_tipos=TRABAJO;EPISODICA;SEMANTICA;PARAMETRICA (most comprehensive/maximalist design in this batch). Sec.4: RL Memory Manager 'learns optimal memory operations (ADD,UPDATE,DELETE,NOOP)' (Sec.4.1, sequential decision problem) -> operaciones=WRITE;ADMISION(NOOP=decline-to-write);ACTUALIZACION;OLVIDO;CONSOLIDACION(Sec.3.3.2 Hierarchical Consolidation), trigger=DISCRECIONAL-LLM. Sec.3.3.3: multi-graph traversal (semantic=embedding similarity->EMBEDDINGS, entity=Personalized PageRank->GRAFO) -> retrieval=EMBEDDINGS;GRAFO. mide_lectura=NO: no ACTUAL measurement of ContextDB's own retrieval precision exists (only planned) -- consequently evidencia_tipo=CUALITATIVA ONLY (architecture description + Fig.2 illustrative walkthrough, no controlled evaluation) and metricas=NINGUNA (nothing actually measured about its own system). Sec.3.1/3.5: bitemporal (event-time vs ingestion-time) tracking + entity-graph conflict detection resolved via 'more recent event time wins' -> fidelidad_procedencia=SI/FIDELIDAD (structural design, not empirically validated). F differs from F_screening(WRITE;MULTIAGENTE;FIDELIDAD;COSTO): KEPT WRITE/MULTIAGENTE/FIDELIDAD, DROPPED COSTO (the 80-90% token-savings claim is explicitly unvalidated/projected per Sec.6.4-6.5), ADDED SEGURIDAD+CONSOLIDACION. Sec.3.5: Shared Memory Bus (pub-sub) + role-aware routing feeds relevant memory CONTENT to each agent -> handoff=CONTENIDO, multiagente=SI. alcance=PROYECTO (memory serves one deployed multi-agent application's full cross-session/cross-channel workload; 'thousands of organizations' is the target MARKET, not evidence of one org-scoped deployment). Named target benchmarks (results pending) listed in benchmarks field despite being unreported. plan_estado=NO (working-memory scratchpad tracks open issues/claims, not task-plan progress).

title: Communication Compression Memory Management and Cooperative Reasoning in Multi-Agent Systems
senal_calidad: STRONG RECONSIDERAR FLAG: (a) three of four listed authors share the first name 'Noah' (Cabrera, Nystrom, Bellamy + David Miller), a strong signal of fabricated/synthetic authorship; (b) low-visibility venue (Int'l J. of Information and Communication Technology Trends); (c) MOST IMPORTANTLY the paper's OWN system contains NO LLM component whatsoever -- it is a classical multi-agent DEEP REINFORCEMENT LEARNING (MADDPG/TarMAC/SchedNet baselines, StarCraft Multi-Agent Challenge testbed, vector-quantization + KL-divergence loss) communication-compression paper; the single mention of 'large language models' (Sec.2.3) is only in RELATED WORK describing OTHER authors' work. Appears OFF-TOPIC for an LLM-agentic-memory SMS (likely mis-screened false positive) rather than a genuine agentic-memory paper -- flagged for human reconsideration of inclusion; extracted per protocol regardless. Sec.3.2: three-tier memory -- 'transient sensory buffer' (short-term, continuously overwritten) + 'episodic working memory' (bounded capacity, stores compressed trajectory/peer-message latents for short-term planning/credit assignment, despite the 'episodic' label it is functionally short-term/working memory) -> both map to TRABAJO; 'consolidated semantic knowledge base' -> SEMANTICA -> mem_tipos=TRABAJO;SEMANTICA. Sec.3.1/3.3: vector-quantization codebook (VECTOR) for compressed messages + 'semantic graphs retrieved from long-term memories...merged using a graph neural network layer' (GRAFO) -> representacion=HIBRIDA, retrieval=GRAFO. Sec.3.2: 'active eviction algorithm' (OLVIDO) triggered because 'the capacity of episodic memory is strictly bounded' (PRESUPUESTO); info 'selectively transferred between tiers' into 'consolidated semantic memory' (CONSOLIDACION) -> operaciones=WRITE;CONSOLIDACION;OLVIDO, trigger=PRESUPUESTO. Table2 ablation: 'No Memory Management' collapses win-rate 93.8%->71.4% (Memory Rate='Zero') -- ablates memory EXISTENCE/write broadly, not an isolated retrieval-precision test -> mide_lectura=NO. Table1: proposed CCMM-CR reaches 93.8% win-rate (vs uncompressed MADDPG upper-bound 94.2%) while cutting bandwidth to 14.7% and memory footprint to 45MB (vs 250MB) -> evidencia_tipo=BENCHMARK-E2E;ABLATION;MEDICION-COSTO, metricas=EXITO;LATENCIA;OTRA(bandwidth/memory-footprint). Sec.3.3: belief update 'weighs incoming information against...the HISTORICAL RELIABILITY OF THE TRANSMITTING AGENT' -> fidelidad_procedencia=SI/FIDELIDAD (source-reliability-weighted trust). F differs from F_screening(MULTIAGENTE;COSTO): added WRITE, CONSOLIDACION, FIDELIDAD. Quantized/graph-merged messages ARE the content exchanged between agents -> handoff=CONTENIDO. alcance=TAREA (per-episode RL memory bounded by 'the integration period' of one trajectory; no evidence of cross-episode/deployment persistence). plan_estado=NO (a 'unified plan of action' is computed on-the-fly via graph merge, not stored/tracked as retrievable progress-state).

title: Cross-Agent Memory Architecture with Contextual Coherence and Factually Grounded Multi-Agent System
senal_calidad: MODERATE RECONSIDERAR FLAG: the abstract's headline claim ('28% reduction in hallucination rates and 35% improvement in task completion accuracy compared to agents that lack memory') is NEVER substantiated by any table/section in the paper body -- Sec.5 Results only reports Table1 (cross-LLM-PROVIDER comparison at FIXED memory architecture, not a with/without-memory ablation) and Table2 (N=240 user-satisfaction Likert survey); no with/without-memory experiment producing 28%/35% appears anywhere in the text, so evidencia_tipo excludes ABLATION despite the abstract's implication. Sec.3.3/3.4: 'Episodic memory (Qdrant vector database)...saves entire shopping experiences' -> EPISODICA; MongoDB 'organized repository of long-term user preferences (brand loyalty, budget boundaries, purchasing history)' -> SEMANTICA; orchestration layer 'keeps immediate context in cache memory throughout the active conversation' -> TRABAJO -> mem_tipos=TRABAJO;EPISODICA;SEMANTICA, representacion=HIBRIDA (Qdrant vector store + MongoDB structured records). Sec.4.2: agents 'write and query the memory...using text embeddings produced by sentence-based transformer models', refined with 'metadata filters' (topic/time/source tags) -> retrieval=EMBEDDINGS. Sec.3.1: 'Once finished, it uploads the entire session as an episodic entry' + 'Updates the MongoDB user preferences database' -> operaciones=WRITE;ACTUALIZACION, trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA (session-completion checkpoint). Table2: 'Search Relevance' user-rated 3.75/5 (N=240, 65.5% rated 4-5) explicitly measuring perceived 'precision and efficiency of the preference extraction and retrieval algorithms' -> mide_lectura=SI/RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO (a soft/subjective but direct measurement of reading utility), evidencia_tipo=CUALITATIVA(user survey)+BENCHMARK-E2E(Table1: Pref.F1/Rec.Relevance/Time across 9 LLM providers, e.g. Qwen3-32B F1=1.00,Rel=4.7,74s vs Groq-Llama3-8b F1=0.78,Rel=4.1,22s). metricas=EXITO(Pref.F1,Rec.Relevance);LATENCIA(Avg.Total-Time);OTRA(composite satisfaction score 3.63/5). No explicit staleness/provenance-verification mechanism beyond time/source metadata tags used for FILTERING (not fidelity-checking) -> fidelidad_procedencia=NO. F differs from F_screening(MULTIAGENTE;RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO): added WRITE only. Memory Inquiry Agent's retrieved context feeds the OTHER 5 crew agents (Preference-Extraction/Product-Search/Comparison/Markdown-Parser/Database) in the pipeline -> handoff=CONTENIDO, multiagente=SI (ShopAgent Crew, CrewAI orchestration). 'Agents...access, adjust and ask about context across different SESSIONS' + MongoDB preferences persist 'across a variety of sessions' -> alcance=SESION. No named external benchmark (proprietary shopping-assistant + synthetic/real-world tasks, N=240 user study) -> benchmarks=NINGUNO. No plan/progress-state memory content -> plan_estado=NO.

title: Learning When to Remember: Risk-Sensitive Contextual Bandits for Abstention-Aware Memory Retrieval in LLM-Based Coding Agents
senal_calidad: S2.1/Eq.6, Fig.2: pattern-variant-episode memory schema mi=(pi,Vi,Ei) -- pattern(canonical repository-agnostic symptom+root-cause class)+variant(context-specific fix strategy+command/path/stack signatures)+episode(concrete observed failure+validation+feedback) -> mem_tipos=PROCEDIMENTAL(reusable fix-strategy knowledge, explicit repair-procedure focus)+EPISODICA(episode layer=concrete observed past-failure instances). representacion: S2.9 'The benchmark implementation is local-first and deterministic: it does not require hosted LLM calls, EXTERNAL EMBEDDING SERVICES, or network access' -- NO vector embeddings used; retrieval evidence is lexical/structural/entity/command/path/stack matching (S2.3/2.4) -> representacion=DOCS-ARCHIVOS, retrieval=GREP-ARCHIVOS(lexical baseline 'lexical_only')+RANKING(candidate compatibility scoring st,i=F(qt,ct,i), top1/top2-score+margin features, Table1). CRITICAL SCOPE STATEMENT (S8, Related Work discussion): 'RSCB-MC does much less than any of these [Memory-R1/Agentic Memory/MIRIX]. It does NOT WRITE memory, does not compress memory off-line, does not resolve contradictions between competing entries, and does not decide when an old episode should be retired. It only answers ONE QUESTION AT READ TIME: is this retrieved memory safe to inject right now?' -> operaciones=NA (paper explicitly disclaims write/admission-at-write/consolidation/forgetting; its entire mechanism is a READ-TIME injection gate) and correspondingly trigger=NA (no write/consolidate/forget trigger to characterize). mide_lectura=SI: the ENTIRE evaluation (Recall@1/3, MRR, nDCG@3, false-positive rate, offline-replay success rate, hot-path proxy success) IS a direct measurement of read/injection-decision utility -> RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO in F (mandatory, rule3). alcance=PROYECTO: 'repository-local operational knowledge' explicitly reused across many debugging episodes within the SAME codebase over time (S1), beyond a single task/session. multiagente=NO (single coding agent). fidelidad_procedencia=SI: the system's core function IS a safety/verification gate deciding whether retrieved memory is trustworthy enough to inject ('is this retrieved memory safe to inject right now', S1) using historical-false-positive-rate/session-rejection/structural-compatibility features (Table1) -- squarely FIDELIDAD (verification before use). NEGATIVO in F: central finding is that naive similarity-based memory injection ACTIVELY HURTS ('it actively pushed the agent down the wrong repair branch', S1) -- 5 concrete real-repo failure pairs given as negative-evidence-about-memory (P5-style). Eq.12-13/S2.6: reward gamma(4.0)>alpha(2.0)>beta(1.0), false-positive penalty explicitly 2-4x larger than injection bonuses -> COSTO in F (design centers on a fast <=331.466us hot-path decision, explicit no-hosted-LLM/no-network-call efficiency constraint). S3.3+: Full RSCB-MC=62.5% best non-oracle offline-replay success/0.0% FPR; 200-case hot-path=60.5% proxy success/0.0% FPR/331.466us p95 latency -> metricas=EXITO;LATENCIA, evidencia_tipo=BENCHMARK-E2E(multi-baseline comparison incl. epsilon-greedy/UCB1/Thompson/LinUCB/oracle) + ABLATION(explicit ablations+reward-sensitivity+context-budget-proxy artifacts, Table3) + MEDICION-COSTO(p95 latency). Evidence explicitly scoped as 'local, deterministic, and proxy-based rather than a causal online LLM-agent deployment study' (S3.1) -- an honest methodological limitation, not a membership-inclusion concern (no RECONSIDERAR). F_screening was WRITE;RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO;COSTO; full text explicitly DISCLAIMS write (S8) so WRITE is DROPPED, and FIDELIDAD+NEGATIVO are added.

title: Hijacking Agent Memory: Stealthy Trojan Attacks Through Conversational Interaction
senal_calidad: S2 targets 3 generic memory-augmented agent architectures (MemGPT paging / A-Mem structured notes / Mem0-LangMem extract-update pipelines), agnostic to a specific memory-content taxonomy -> mem_tipos=NA. S5.1 retrieval is embedding-similarity-driven across 8 encoder backbones -> representacion=VECTOR, retrieval=EMBEDDINGS. S4.1 attack targets the selective EXTRACTION+REWRITING pipeline (the WRITE/ADMISION gate deciding what enters memory: 'agents autonomously extract and store information from user inputs', S1) -> operaciones=WRITE;ADMISION, trigger=DISCRECIONAL-LLM (extraction pipeline is LLM-driven). S5.1 Agents/Datasets: Personal Agent x LongMemEval[42], Medical Agent x MIRIAD[50], Financial Agent x FinQA[6]; 2000 benign memory entries per agent (mature-system init), 100 held-out QA test queries per agent, 3 memory mechanisms + standard RAG baseline. Metrics ISR(injection-success)/RSR@1(retrieval-success)/ASR(attack-success)/ACC(benign accuracy) -> RSR@1 is a direct retrieval-precision measurement -> mide_lectura=SI/RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO. Table1(S5.2): MemPoison ASR up to 0.95 while ACC stays close to clean-agent baseline, outperforming AgentPoison/MINJA/Naive-Concat/Info-only; key finding = baselines show a large ISR-vs-RSR@1 gap because naive trigger+payload concatenation gets split into separate memory entries during extraction (only the trigger-entry is retrieved, payload lost) -> semantic-relational-bridge ablation (RQ2) confirms the bridge is load-bearing -> evidencia_tipo=ABLATION;BENCHMARK-E2E. S3 'Shared Agent Platform' scenario (Fig.2): multiple USERS (not multiple LLM agents) share one agent's memory (e.g. clinician team via shared EHR) -> classified multiagente=NO (multi-USER sharing, not multi-AGENT memory sharing per RQ4 definition) -- flagged for spot-check, RECONSIDERAR not warranted (paper correctly scoped as SEGURIDAD single-agent attack). No provenance/staleness verification discussed -> fidelidad_procedencia=NO. Persistent dormant backdoor across sessions until triggered ('cross-session continuity', 'hijacking the agent's behavior over an extended period') -> alcance=PROYECTO. F differs from F_screening (SEGURIDAD) by adding RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO per RSR@1 anchor.

title: RAMPART: Registry-based Agentic Memory with Priority-Aware Runtime Transformation
senal_calidad: Sec.2.1: instruction block (id,content,priority,source,author,removable,run,created,accesses,embedding) held in an in-RAM OrderedDict registry; content = 'domain rules, persona definitions, safety constraints, learned heuristics' + tool schemas generalising SKILL.md (Sec.1) -> mem_tipos=TRABAJO(session-local compiled context)+PROCEDIMENTAL(instruction/skill/tool-use knowledge); representacion=HIBRIDA (structured block objects + dense embedding per block for relevance gating). Table4/Sec.2.6: five primitives promote/gate/write/evict/rollback are explicit agent/caller-invoked API calls (write_block/write_agent_block tagged with calling registry's author UUID) -> trigger=DISCRECIONAL-LLM; relevance gate runs automatically as stage1 of every compile() call -> trigger also EVENTO-DETERMINISTA. Sec.2.2/2.4: relevance gating is 'a pre-compilation filter that determines what enters context' (cosine over all-MiniLM-L6-v2 embeddings) -> retrieval=EMBEDDINGS, operaciones=ADMISION; write_block/write_agent_block -> WRITE; evict operation ('Removes block from registry permanently') -> OLVIDO. Sec.3.2/Fig1c/Sec.'gating': relevance gating measured directly against task success -- gated condition (1405 vs 4367 tokens, 67.8% token reduction) recovers 83% of the promoted-condition's success rate (5/20 vs 6/20-scale) -> mide_lectura=SI, F includes RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO. Sec.2.1/2.5: block provenance (source in{seed,agent,orchestrator}, author UUID), non-evictable authorship flags, provenance-report primitive returning full lineage by source/run -> fidelidad_procedencia=SI, F FIDELIDAD. Sec.2.1: session-local UUID4 randomisation explicitly 'provides explicit protection against indirect prompt injection' targeting blocks by semantic name -> F SEGURIDAD (memory-poisoning-adjacent, not memory-for-security). Sec.2.6 shared-registry coordination: one registry writes a block directly into another's ordered dict at zero token cost -> multiagente=SI, handoff=CONTENIDO. Table3: compile() 5.6-12.5us, find_relevant() 4.4-5.9ms, cold start 230ms -> metricas LATENCIA; token-cost table (Table4) all-zero except compile output -> metricas COSTO-TOKENS; tool-schema eviction: 100%->0% invocation rate -> evidencia_tipo also BENCHMARK-E2E (access-control experiment). alcance=SESION: registry is populated per session (session-local address randomisation, 'session load and snapshot restore'), seed library persists but working registries are session-scoped. F differs from F_screening(WRITE;MULTIAGENTE;COSTO): added RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO, FIDELIDAD, SEGURIDAD, PROCEDIMENTAL. Authors explicitly frame all quantitative results as 'controlled probes... not general-purpose benchmarks' (Sec.3.1) -- single-author preprint, results scoped narrowly but methodologically transparent (pre-flight ceiling/floor checks reported); no RECONSIDERAR flag warranted, methodology is unusually rigorous for a single-author non-peer-reviewed arXiv paper.

title: StreamMemBench: Streaming Evaluation of Agent Memory for Future-Oriented Assistance
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR (duda leve): el paper es un benchmark de EVALUACION de 8 sistemas de memoria EXTERNOS (RAGraw, RAGext, Mem0, EverMemOS, A-Mem, MemOS, MemoryOS, MemSkill) tratados como caja negra -- no propone su propia arquitectura de memoria, similar en genero al paper de curriculum RL (e65). mem_tipos=NA (regla5): el paper no propone mecanismo de memoria propio; MIDE en su lugar la trayectoria completa desde evidencia observada en un stream egocentrico hasta su USO en una tarea inicial, INCORPORACION de feedback, y REUTILIZACION en una tarea de seguimiento relacionada, via 4 metricas trazables por ancla de evidencia: Fidelity (retencion), IEU (uso inicial), FI (incorporacion de feedback), FUR (reutilizacion en seguimiento) (Sec.3.2, Fig.2). representacion=NA, operaciones=NA, trigger=NA, retrieval=NA: cada uno de los 8 sistemas evaluados usa su PROPIA arquitectura/representacion/operaciones/retrieval interna y heterogenea (fact-level Mem0, jerarquico MemOS/MemoryOS, chunk-linking A-Mem, skills MemSkill, RAG crudo/extraido) -- el benchmark es agnostico/caja-negra a estos ejes ('Task-side evaluation is black-box. We do not inspect M's internal memory state', Sec.3.2), por lo que el paper mismo no define ninguno de estos ejes. mide_lectura=SI: IEU y FUR miden DIRECTAMENTE si la respuesta del agente USA la evidencia recuperada/memorizada -> F incluye RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO. alcance=PROYECTO: memoria personal continua sobre un stream egocentrico de 7 dias (EgoLife, 6 participantes), no acotada a una sesion de dialogo. multiagente=NO: agente personal, un usuario. fidelidad_procedencia=SI: la metrica Fidelity verifica explicitamente que la informacion en el delta de memoria tenga 'the correct participant attribution, temporal scope, and factuality' (Sec.3.2) -- verificacion de procedencia/atribucion/veracidad del contenido almacenado, medida independientemente para los 8 sistemas (Tabla 2). benchmarks=StreamMemBench (propio: 3347 segmentos de 5 min, 8107 anclas de evidencia, 16214 queries, sobre EgoLife). metricas=EXITO (tasas de aprobacion Fidelity/IEU/FI/FUR, Tabla 2, metrica primaria) + COSTO-TOKENS (Sec.4 menciona comparacion de costo de almacenamiento y computo entre sistemas). evidencia_tipo=BENCHMARK-E2E (Tabla 2: 8 sistemas x 2 backbones x 4 metricas) + CUALITATIVA (categorizacion de patrones de fallo, Sec.4 intro 'categorize failure patterns'; analisis de deriva temporal por posicion en el stream, Fig.3). F=NEGATIVO en sentido (b): hallazgo central explicitamente negativo sobre la efectividad de los sistemas de memoria evaluados ('current memory systems are not yet reliable for future-oriented assistance... often failing', Introduccion) pese a que muchos retienen la evidencia correctamente. handoff=CONTENIDO: la interaccion completa (tarea+respuesta+feedback+respuesta post-feedback) se compromete a la memoria via Phi y debe viajar de la tarea inicial a la tarea de seguimiento para lograr FUR (Sec.3.2). plan_estado=SI: 'Evidence is retained only when it can affect a future personal-assistance request, such as a long-term preference, PLAN, commitment or capability' (Sec.3.1); 'activity planning' y 'plan evaluation' son tipos de tarea explicitos evaluados (Sec.4.1).

title: Anchor-Aware Memory Systems for AI Agents: Discovering and Preserving Latent Behavioral Signatures in Large Language Models
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: paper de un solo autor, autopublicado (repo GitHub, sin venue/arXiv formal visible en el PDF), metodologia psicometrica ad-hoc (24 probes forzados) sobre 4 modelos pequenos (7-14B) sin comparacion con sistemas de memoria de agentes existentes; la relevancia para las RQ de memoria de agentes es indirecta (perfil de personalidad como señal de compresion) mas que un mecanismo de memoria propiamente dicho -- se extrae igual por instruccion del protocolo. mem_tipos=EPISODICA: la capa 'Memory' (Tabla 1, S2.1) almacena 'conversation history, extracted knowledge', comprimida selectivamente. representacion=DOCS-ARCHIVOS: mensajes de texto retenidos/descartados, sin vector store ni grafo explicitos. operaciones=ADMISION;OLVIDO: el compresor anchor-aware retiene/descarta mensajes segun relevancia a las dimensiones ancla (formula de peso S7.2). trigger=CHECKPOINT: compresion cada 10 rondas en el test de 50 rondas (Tabla 8, S7.3). retrieval/mide_lectura=NA/NO: no se describe mecanismo de lectura/recuperacion, solo escritura+compresion. F ajustado desde F_screening=CONSOLIDACION;FIDELIDAD -> se retiene solo CONSOLIDACION (compresion, S7) porque FIDELIDAD en el formulario refiere a consistencia ENTRE FUENTES de memoria (regla 7 del prompt: 'costuras'), mientras este paper mide consistencia CONDUCTUAL/identidad del modelo (soul signature), un eje distinto no cubierto por las facetas cerradas. evidencia_tipo=CUALITATIVA: demo de un solo pipeline (SoulMate) en modelos locales pequenos sin baseline de sistemas de memoria comparables (Tabla 8, S7.3); metricas propias (cosine similarity, tasas de retencion) sin marco de evaluacion externo (misma vara E de la calibracion, demos=CUALITATIVA).

title: Context Engineering at Enterprise Scale: Multi-Signal Scope Resolution for AI-Assisted Software Development
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: el paper es sobre un algoritmo de RESOLUCION DE ALCANCE (mapear un work item en lenguaje natural a repositorios de codigo fuente) sobre un catalogo empresarial ESTATICO (no memoria acumulada por interaccion/observacion de un agente) -- mas cercano a 'context engineering'/busqueda de codigo empresarial que a memoria de agente LLM en el sentido de este formulario (RQ1/RQ2 sobre TIPOS/OPERACIONES de memoria no aplican limpiamente); se extrae igual por instruccion del protocolo. mem_tipos=NA, representacion=NA, operaciones=NA, trigger=NA: el paper no describe COMO se escribe/gestiona el catalogo (eso es el tema del paper companero W7165042005); aqui el catalogo es un insumo estatico ya enriquecido (871 repos con metadata, capacidades, embeddings de 3072-d via gemini-embedding-001, Sec.III-A). retrieval=GREP-ARCHIVOS (Layer 1 tag exact-match + Layer 2 full-text search sobre indice Redis, ambos deterministicos/lexicos) + EMBEDDINGS (Layer 4, vector KNN HNSW con gemini-embedding-001, Eq.2) + RANKING (agregacion de 5 capas con rangos de score acotados + umbral dual + Layer 5 re-scoring aditivo, Sec.III-C/D). mide_lectura=SI: TODA la evaluacion mide directamente el exito de la resolucion/recuperacion (94.6% tasa de exito, Tabla III ablation de capas, Tabla IV comparacion de baselines) -> F incluye RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO. alcance=ORGANIZACION: catalogo empresarial completo compartido por 70+ equipos de desarrollo de una empresa Fortune 50 (Sec.V.A), no acotado a tarea/sesion/proyecto individual. multiagente=NO: recuperacion independiente por consulta, no memoria compartida entre agentes cooperantes (aunque el catalogo es usado por muchos equipos, cada resolucion es una consulta aislada). fidelidad_procedencia=NO: no hay verificacion activa de staleness/procedencia en ESTE paper (aunque 'repos recien anadidos aun no enriquecidos' es un modo de fallo reconocido, no se verifica/senaliza activamente). benchmarks=catalogo interno de 871 repos; 178 consultas para ablation/baseline (Tabla III-IV); 879 ejecuciones de pipeline en produccion (Sec.V.B). metricas=EXITO (94.6% tasa de exito de resolucion, IC95%[92.9%,96.0%]; cobertura % en ablation) + LATENCIA ('sub-second resolution latency', Sec.V.G; <5ms para extraccion regex sincrona). evidencia_tipo=ABLATION (Tabla III: cobertura por configuracion de capas L1-L5, n=178) + BENCHMARK-E2E (Tabla IV: sistema multi-senal vs baselines de estrategia unica -- keyword/vector/capability-only) + MEDICION-COSTO (latencia sub-segundo, presupuesto de API de GitHub, Sec.IV). handoff=NO: resolucion de una sola consulta por work item, sin protocolo de traspaso entre sesiones/agentes. plan_estado=NO: no hay contenido de estado de plan/progreso, solo metadata de repositorios.

title: Context Engineering for Agentic Systems: A Five-Phase Pipeline for Enterprise Repository Knowledge Extraction
senal_calidad: RECONSIDERAR: paper companero de W7165013794 (mismo autor/sistema), sobre el pipeline de ENRIQUECIMIENTO (escritura) del catalogo empresarial -- describe una ETL de documentacion de codigo (crawl GitHub + regex + AST + resumen LLM + embeddings), NO memoria acumulada por observacion/interaccion de un agente propio; se extrae igual por instruccion del protocolo, mas cercano a 'context engineering'/construccion de base de conocimiento que a memoria de agente en sentido estricto. mem_tipos=SEMANTICA: el catalogo almacena conocimiento general/organizacional (que servicios existen, que capacidades exponen, como se interconectan, que APIs exponen -- Abstract), no experiencia episodica/personal de un agente. representacion=HIBRIDA: entradas de catalogo estructuradas en Redis (Fig.4: campos por fase: metadata cruda, dependencias/integraciones regex, endpoints/llamadas AST, capacidades/resumen LLM) + embeddings de 3072-d (Fase 5). operaciones=WRITE (enriquecimiento inicial de un repo nuevo, Fase 1-5) + CONSOLIDACION (fusion por prioridad estricta de las 5 fases en una sola entrada de catalogo: AST=verdad-terreno inmutable > regex=linea base > LLM=mejora aditiva que nunca sobrescribe, Fig.2, Sec.III-D) + ACTUALIZACION ('users can trigger re-enrichment on demand at any time to ensure freshness', Sec.V.F -- mecanismo EXPLICITO de actualizacion bajo demanda). trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA: nuevo repo detectado o solicitud explicita de re-enriquecimiento del usuario, ambos eventos deterministicos del sistema, no discrecion del LLM sobre CUANDO escribir (el LLM solo aporta CONTENIDO en la Fase 4). retrieval=EMBEDDINGS: Fase 5 genera embeddings de 3072-d (task type RETRIEVAL_DOCUMENT) que habilitan busqueda de similitud vectorial en la capa de resolucion de alcance (Sec.III-E) -- el uso/consumo de estos embeddings para RECUPERAR se describe en el paper companero, no aqui. mide_lectura=NO: la evaluacion de ESTE paper mide la calidad de ESCRITURA/enriquecimiento (95% accuracy, Tabla II; ablation de la estrategia de fusion, Sec.V.C), NO la efectividad de la lectura/recuperacion de memoria (eso se mide en el paper companero W7165013794, aqui solo se CITA su 94.6% como 'Downstream Impact', Sec.V.E) -> F NO incluye RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO. F_screening traia RETRIEVAL-MEDIDO por defecto; se CORRIGE tras lectura completa porque este paper especifico no mide lectura, mide fidelidad de escritura. alcance=ORGANIZACION: catalogo compartido por 80+ equipos de desarrollo de una empresa Fortune 50 (~900 repos). multiagente=NO: catalogo compartido como recurso estatico, no memoria de coordinacion entre agentes cooperantes. fidelidad_procedencia=SI: mecanismo EXPLICITO y MEDIDO -- 'AST-detected metadata (Phase 3) is immutable ground truth that LLM output (Phase 4) cannot override' (Sec.V.C); sin esta restriccion el catalogo tendria ~8% de endpoints alucinados por el LLM (ablation cuantificada, Sec.V.C). benchmarks=catalogo interno ~900 repos; 60 repos con evaluacion de campo detallada por equipo (Tabla II). metricas=EXITO (~95% accuracy de enriquecimiento, Tabla II; 5-8x mas campos consultables que catalog-info.yaml manual, Tabla III) + LATENCIA (~100s por repo estandar, 5-6 min por monorepo, Tabla I). evidencia_tipo=ABLATION (Sec.V.C 'Ablation: Merge Strategy Validation', cuantifica alucinaciones con/sin regla AST-override) + BENCHMARK-E2E (Tabla III: pipeline vs catalog-info.yaml manual en 9 campos) + MEDICION-COSTO (Tabla I: tiempo de enriquecimiento por fase/repo). handoff=NO: catalogo estatico consumido por multiples clientes downstream (resolucion de alcance, registro de skills, herramientas de gestion de cambios, Sec.III-G), sin protocolo de traspaso sesion-a-sesion o agente-a-agente propio de esta memoria. plan_estado=NO: contenido de metadata de repositorios (capacidades, dependencias, APIs), no estado de plan/progreso de tarea.

title: AutoDevOS: AI-Driven Autonomous Software Development Orchestrator using Model Context Protocol
senal_calidad: QUALITY/RECONSIDERAR FLAG: published in 'International Journal of Science, Engineering and Technology' (low-indexing/predatory-profile venue), student capstone project ('winning first place at the project poster presentation', MET's Institute of Engineering undergraduate team); 'Quantitative Evaluation Metrics' section (Sec.VIII) reports round percentages (85% task completion, 40% dev-time reduction, 70% error recovery, '>50 turns') with no dataset description, no baseline numbers, no statistical methodology, no ablation isolating the memory component -- plausible low-rigor self-reported claims; extracted per protocol, inclusion decision left to human reviewer. Sec.V/'Context Manager': 'token estimation, summarisation prompts, and sliding-window pruning' to 'circumvent token limits' -> mem_tipos=TRABAJO (session-scoped context, no cross-task persistent representation described), representacion=DOCS-ARCHIVOS (raw context/tool-output text, no vector/graph structure specified), operaciones=CONSOLIDACION(summarisation)+OLVIDO(sliding-window pruning of 'old tool outputs'), trigger=PRESUPUESTO (explicitly token-limit/context-window driven). Future Work explicitly lists 'Deepening the integration of vector-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)' as NOT YET implemented -> retrieval=NA, mide_lectura=NO (no retrieval-quality measurement exists). alcance=TAREA: context/to-do state scoped to one software-generation session/run; 'persistent memory storage' is listed once in Scope but never elaborated technically, so not counted as cross-project persistence. multiagente=SI (meta-agent + frontend/backend/DevOps/testing/documentation sub-agents). Sec.V Mathematical Model + Result Interpretation: 'decomposing tasks into isolated tool invocations (via a persistent To-Do registry)' -- a task/progress list tracked as memory content across the agentic loop -> plan_estado=SI. Sec.VIII metrics: Task Completion Rate 85% -> metricas=EXITO; Development Time Reduction ~40% -> metricas=OTRA (project-level productivity metric, not per-call LATENCIA); Error Recovery Rate 70% also EXITO-like but no separate token/cost figures -> no COSTO-TOKENS. No ablation isolating memory/context-management contribution -> evidencia_tipo=BENCHMARK-E2E(weak, self-reported)+CUALITATIVA(UML/architecture narrative dominates the paper). fidelidad_procedencia=NO: no source/staleness verification of context content described (only code-diff user-approval, which is a safety gate not a memory-provenance mechanism). F differs from F_screening(MULTIAGENTE): added CONSOLIDACION, COSTO (dev-time/token-limit cost discussion). handoff=CONTENIDO: meta-agent assigns sub-task descriptions t_i to specialised agents (Eq. M(P)=T={t1..tn}), i.e. task content travels between agents.

title: HyphaeDB: A Living Knowledge Topology for Agent-First Memory
senal_calidad: QUALITY NOTE (not RECONSIDERAR, but explicitly self-flagged by the authors): Sec.9.2 Limitations states plainly 'The emergent behaviors described in Section 5 are theoretically motivated but not yet empirically validated' -- no experiments were run; extraction reflects this honestly (evidencia_tipo=CUALITATIVA only, benchmarks/metricas=NINGUNO/NINGUNA). Sec.3.1: knowledge nodes = cells (decisions,facts,patterns,risks,lessons,constraints) with salience/confidence scores in Rd=1536 vector space -> mem_tipos=SEMANTICA; representacion=HIBRIDA (HNSW vector-space positions + explicit topology-edge table, multi-layer Layer0/1/2). operaciones: WRITE(sdd_memory_store), CONSOLIDACION(Sec.5.3 pattern crystallization: consolidation worker detects cluster density, extracts generalized pattern via LLM, scene nodes 'produced by consolidation'), OLVIDO(Sec.5.4 organic decay), ACTUALIZACION(diff types include updated/superseded, Eq.4). trigger=EVENTO-DETERMINISTA: gossip propagation fires 'when a knowledge change occurs' (Algorithm1); layer promotion triggered by confirmation-count thresholds (>=5 nodes/scene, >=3 scenes, Sec.4.3). retrieval=EMBEDDINGS: cosine-similarity relevance scoring drives gossip routing (Algorithm1 line8, sigma=0.6r+0.3iota+0.1s) and standard pgvector HNSW search remains available for direct queries (Sec.5.4: stale cells 'remain searchable in Layer0 for direct queries'). mide_lectura=NO: no retrieval/routing efficacy measurement performed (theoretical only). alcance=PROYECTO: Sec.9.2 'The current design operates within a single project'; Layer2 explicitly = 'project-level' scope (architectural decisions/constraints); cross-project transfer named as future work. multiagente=SI (agent nodes, Swarm-Driven Development reference deployment: spec/code/review/test agents). fidelidad_procedencia=SI: Sec.7.3 'session management tools for provenance tracking' among the 10 MCP tools, per-cell confidence score, contradiction-detection mechanism. F differs from F_screening(MULTIAGENTE only): added WRITE, CONSOLIDACION, FIDELIDAD, SEGURIDAD (adversarial-injection/poisoning risk explicitly named in Limitations, matching rule7's seguridad-DE-memoria definition even though unmitigated). handoff=CONTENIDO: memory diffs (change notifications carrying embeddings+content) are literally what propagates agent-to-agent via gossip (Sec.4.1/5.1 worked example). plan_estado=NO: cell types are decisions/facts/patterns/risks/lessons/constraints, no explicit plan/progress-state type.

title: Memory Is Not Live State — Cross-Agent Memory Governance by Transplanting the Reflective Context Governor onto Agent Memory (memgov v0.1.0)
senal_calidad: QUALITY/RECONSIDERAR FLAG: self-published preprint (author's own company MOBIUS LLC; DOI 'reserved, live on Zenodo publication' i.e. not yet formally deposited at extraction time), near-total self-citation (7 of 9 references are the same author's own prior deposits), explicit 'AI co-observer: Claude Fable 5' co-drafting disclosure, and the evidence base is a SINGLE workspace over a SINGLE day (author's own Sec.9 Limitations: 'Single workspace, single day, two agents... this is not yet evidence of general usefulness'); extracted per protocol, inclusion decision left to human reviewer -- note the paper is unusually self-aware/transparent about these limits (explicit falsifiability section, Sec.8). Sec.1: memory = Markdown files agents write at session end describing project/status facts -> mem_tipos=SEMANTICA (status-bearing claims about world state, e.g. 'not yet deposited (DOI:TBD)'), representacion=DOCS-ARCHIVOS ('both agents' memories are Markdown on disk', explicitly 'no embeddings, no model calls' Sec.6). operaciones=WRITE(session-end writes) + ACTUALIZACION(SHARED_STATE rows 'overwritten in place by whichever session changes durable state'); no OLVIDO ('Nothing is auto-deleted'). trigger: memory writes at session end + drift-scan/freshness-heartbeat run via SessionStart hooks (EVENTO-DETERMINISTA); freshness heartbeat also threshold-based (files untouched beyond 2 days, suppressed 3 days after reconciliation) -> CHECKPOINT. retrieval=GREP-ARCHIVOS: 'Deterministic and inspectable. Regex over Markdown; no embeddings' (Sec.6). mide_lectura=NO: the scanner measures STALENESS/drift precision (a fidelity axis), not retrieval-for-use quality; no relevance-ranked reading mechanism exists to measure. alcance=PROYECTO: SHARED_STATE spans the whole 'MOBIUS workspace' (multiple repos, both agents), cross-session. multiagente=SI (Claude Code + GPT Codex, cross-agent governance is the paper's core contribution). fidelidad_procedencia=SI (the paper's entire mechanism: verification anchors, drift detection, commitment surface, append-only measurement ledger). metricas=OTRA: suspected-drift counts (17->14) and queue precision (true positives vs noise) are a domain-specific detection metric, not EXITO/ITERACION/COSTO-TOKENS/LATENCIA; time-to-detection and repair-latency are stated as PLANNED (Sec.8) not yet measured with numbers. evidencia_tipo=BENCHMARK-E2E(a real production system measured on real data: 73 files, 17->14 drifts)+CUALITATIVA(the incident narrative and root-cause analysis dominate the paper). F differs from F_screening(FIDELIDAD;MULTIAGENTE): added WRITE, NEGATIVO (the paper's central contribution IS documenting a real memory-system failure/near-miss -- rule7(b) evidencia negativa sobre memoria). handoff=CONTENIDO: SHARED_STATE row overwrite is explicitly named in the text as 'the cross-agent handoff' (Sec.4, component1). plan_estado=SI: status-bearing claims tracked as memory ('not yet deposited','awaiting owner review before deposit','HOLD') are literally task/deliverable progress-state content.
